controls.name: privacy_notice
controls.placeholder:
What we hold, and why

We are an inspection company. To do the work you or your employer asked for, this system holds:
  · the name, designation, e-mail and phone number of the people we deal with at client and vendor companies, so that inspections can be arranged and reports sent;
  · for our own staff, the details needed to employ them and to schedule work;
  · the inspection records themselves — dates, findings, photographs taken on site, and who approved what.

Why we are allowed to hold it
Most of it is needed to perform a contract. Inspection records are kept because our clients, and the standards we work to, require them to be kept.

How long we keep it
Contact details for as long as we work with that company. Inspection records and the trail of who changed what for the period our clients and the applicable standards require.

Who else sees it
Nobody outside this company, except where a client is entitled to the report of their own inspection, or where the law requires it. The system sends nothing to any other service.

What you can ask for
A copy of what we hold about you, a correction, deletion, or the withdrawal of consent you gave earlier. Write to the person named below and we will log it and answer.

Where it is kept
On our hosting account in India.
